title: Awrad places v1: the bundled city list
description: cities.json, generated from GeoNames by tools/build-cities.mjs, and what city search returns. See README.md.

city_id.description: The GeoNames ID. Stable across rebuilds of the list.

name.description: The display name in every app language: GeoNames' ASCII name.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Apps show the country's name from the platform's locale data.

region.description: First-level region (state, province, emirate), GeoNames' ASCII name; null when unknown.

aliases.description: Other names search matches but never shows: Arabic- and Malayalam-script names, capitalised Latin names (Calicut, Trivandrum) and the name with its diacritics. Sorted, no repeats.

attribution.description: Shown in each app's About (the licence requires it).

regions.description: Lower minimum populations by country (SA) or country.admin1 (IN.13, Kerala).
